text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having learned of the pinnacle known as 
the "Twinkle Series" when she was young, 
Narita Top Road's aspirations had resided 
there ever since—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, stepping through the gates of 
Tracen Academy, she met her Trainer, and 
the two exchanged a firm vow to stand 
together at the very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To do that, I first need to catch up to 
"that Umamusume"—the one who hasn't even 
debuted yet, but is already commanding 
such a presence—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega—beyond her lies the pinnacle. 
Narita Top Road fixed her gaze upon her 
goal with clear eyes.
